scope: Public source repository readiness; not final APK acceptance or a legal certification

checks: Personal names and absolute home paths
Known GitHub and OpenAI token formats
Private screenshots and build/signing artifacts in historical paths
triaged_false_positives: Upstream numeric 150 and test HTML matched a broad storage-size pattern
Generic home-directory prefix names in an ELF path-mapping test description
sensitive_content.limits: Pattern and path review is not a proof that every possible secret format is absent

images.metadata_check_note: An initial no-metadata assertion rejected a standard Android sRGB ICC profile. Manual review confirmed color-only data; subsequent EXIF and personal-metadata checks passed. The source image was preserved.

distribution.formal_apk_security_performance_and_reso: Remain open; see docs/STATUS.md and docs/COMPLIANCE.md
